sceneSummaryZh: Spider-Man drives his right foot toward Batman’s chest. Batman blocks with his left forearm; his right boot slides back on the wet stone. Spider-Man recoils from the block and plants both feet inside the railing.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Crisp high-detail 3D game cinematics. Night, wet stone rooftop, steel vent on the left, brick stairwell behind, distant blue skyline. Night, cool blue moonlight and distant city glow. steel vent (left). brick stairwell (behind). railing (front). wet stone floor. Spider-Man: Classic red and blue suit, web-shooters on wrists; Screen left, crouched, right leg extended forward; Right foot driving toward Batman's chest; Web-shooters; Ready to strike; present in the action. Batman: Dark grey and black suit, cape, utility belt; Screen right, standing; Left forearm raised to block; Batarang (in belt); Blocking the kick; present in the action. Wet stone floor with visible water trails. A medium-wide composition. The camera holds its position, lens and horizon fixed. Fixed on the railing and vent landmarks. Horizontal, actors facing each other. Show the full causal exchange: kick, block, slide, and repositioning. Spider-Man drives his right foot toward Batman's chest. Batman's left forearm meets Spider-Man's right foot. Batman's right boot slides back on the wet stone. Water squeezes into a narrow trail behind Batman's boot. Batman loses half a step of ground. Sharp thud of foot on forearm, wet scrape of boot on stone. Spider-Man recoils from the block. None (clearance from the block). Spider-Man retracts the leg and plants both feet inside the railing. Wet stone floor shows the new water trail. Spider-Man is now positioned inside the railing, Batman has lost footing. Soft thud of Spider-Man's feet landing. At the end: Night, wet stone rooftop, steel vent on the left, brick stairwell behind, distant blue skyline. Spider-Man: Classic red and blue suit, web-shooters on wrists; Inside the railing, screen left; Both feet planted, right leg retracted; Web-shooters; Repositioned, ready for next move; present in the action. Batman: Dark grey and black suit, cape, utility belt; Screen right, slightly off-balance; Left forearm still raised, right foot slid back; Batarang (in belt); Lost half a step of ground; present in the action.
